name: Ola CEO and Kunal Kamra work 20 hours a day!
description:
First #narayanmurthy said we should work 70 hours. 
Then #OLa CEO #bhavishaggarwal said something else. 
The CEO of #paytm is still awaited - hopefully Vijay Shekhar Sharma will surface. 

Though @KunalKamra may yet have the last laugh.
